item: Import reports are checked as documents in the backup and when served; the beat checks the statement label
summary: The single-file backup parses each import report, checks every value and writes it again (a line copy tore the document when the passphrase was a number or a key name; an unparsable report is withheld with a stub); the report download and listing check an older report as they serve it; the beat scrubs the in-flight statement label; a withheld or torn journal line marks the unfinished-members list as a superset.
